kurz: In Bircher muesli, oat flakes swell overnight in milk or yoghurt. Lemon keeps the grated apple pale.
bild_im_kopf: Like a seed swelling overnight in water: by morning it is soft and plump.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Mix oat flakes with milk or yoghurt and chill overnight
schluesselmomente.warum: The flakes take up liquid, and their starch swells a little even when cold: the muesli turns creamy.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Grate the apple just before eating and mix it straight away with lemon juice
schluesselmomente.warum: In the air an [[enzym|enzyme]] browns the apple. Acid slows it down.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Scatter the nuts over only at the end
schluesselmomente.warum: That way they stay crunchy instead of soaking up moisture.
